skills.name: janus
skills.description: Janus CLI discovery stub. The actual workflow guides live inside the janus CLI; this stub teaches an AI agent to call `janus skills list`, `janus skills get <name>`, and `janus ask <prompt> --guided|--direct`. Use whenever the user asks a data question, wants to install / set up Janus Engine, connect a new database, load SaaS data via dlt, generate or regenerate an MDL project, enrich a project with business context, or build & deploy a shareable GenBI web app / dashboard from a project's semantic layer (Vercel / Cloudflare).
